mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 2% triggers a preemptive market adjustment, lowering real discount rates and pushing S&P 500 forward returns negative over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 2.0 in a single month
failure_condition: Over 60-day window, 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from a 0% baseline (p > 0.05), or CPIAUCSL remains below 2% throughout the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in PAYEMS labor cost index exceeding 0.5% signals wage pressure, prompting higher labor cost assumptions and a negative S&P 500 20-day forward return.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month
failure_condition: Over 100 instances, 20-day forward returns are non-negative when PAYEMS crosses the 0.5% threshold, or IC > 0.05 (p-value).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in GDPC1 personal consumption exceeding 2% suggests weakening demand, which depresses equity valuations and produces a negative 60-day forward return for the S&P 500.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 declines by more than 2% over two consecutive months
failure_condition: Over 5-year windows, 60-day forward returns are not systematically negative when GDPC1 declines >2% in two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in INDPRO manufacturing production index below 90 triggers a supply-side shock that reduces market confidence and yields a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as investors anticipate rate cuts.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 90 index points in a single month
failure_condition: Across 10 such events, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises above 4%, the expected future discount rate increase compresses present value of equities, producing a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return as markets preemptively price in lower growth.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4% in a month
failure_condition: Over 50 such events, 5-day forward returns are not positive (mean <= 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in both PAYEMS and UNRATE above their 2020 averages indicate labor market tightening, which raises expected wage growth and reduces S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: Both PAYEMS > 2020_avg and UNRATE > 2020_avg in the same month
failure_condition: Over 20 such months, 60-day forward returns are not statistically negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in HOUST housing starts of at least 10% predicts reduced future economic momentum, resulting in a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return in a non-recession regime.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls by >= 10% in a single month and is below 2000 for two months
failure_condition: During 100 non-recession months, 20-day returns are not systematically negative when HOUST drops 10% (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS demand for durable goods unexpectedly falls by 15% in a month, it signals weak consumer confidence and a regime-dependent negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return in a steady-state economy.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS decreases by >= 15% in a single month during steady state
failure_condition: Over 50 such events in steady state, 60-day forward returns are not negative (mean > 0).
